data.headline: About Asteroid Metals Co.
data.subheadline: How we source, verify, and deliver certified samples of rare metals recovered from asteroid missions and meteorite finds.

data.headline: Verified origin. Documented purity. Measurable rarity.
data.subheadline: From asteroid to laboratory to your collection.
data.attrImageAlt: Verified origin. Documented purity. Measurable rarity.
data.contentHTML:
Asteroid Metals Co. partners with space agencies and certified meteorite dealers to source rare metals with documented origins. Every sample in our catalog includes spectral analysis, mass verification, and chain-of-custody documentation from recovery to delivery.

Our verification process combines non-destructive testing with isotopic analysis to confirm both elemental purity and extraterrestrial origin. Samples are sealed in inert atmospheres and shipped with full documentation suitable for research or private collection.

items.q: How do you verify asteroid origin?
items.a: We use isotopic analysis and spectral fingerprinting to match samples against known asteroid compositions. Documentation includes mission records for returned samples and witnessed falls for meteorite finds.

items.q: What purity standards do you guarantee?
items.a: Every sample is assayed by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry. We report elemental purity to three significant figures, with full spectral data available upon request.

items.q: Can these samples be used for research?
items.a: Yes. Our documentation package includes spectral data, mass verification, and origin certification suitable for academic citation. Contact us for institutional purchasing and larger quantities.

data.contentHTML:
Review your selected samples below. Because asteroid metal values fluctuate with availability and assay results, we provide confirmed quotes rather than fixed pricing. Submit your cart to receive a detailed quote including shipping, insurance, and estimated delivery timeline.

All shipments include temperature-controlled packaging, chain-of-custody documentation, and signature-required delivery. Institutional buyers may request additional certification or custom assay services.
